name: zerocard_make_payment
description: Get virtual card details (PAN, CVV, expiry) to complete a purchase. Card is reused to save fees unless force_new_card is true. ALWAYS check balance first and report expense after successful payment.

purpose.description: Clear reason for this expense - will be included in spending reports

force_new_card.description: Set TRUE only if privacy is required or previous card was declined. New cards cost $1 issuance fee.
